method: Inputs: gap/verify-gap.json and gap/gap-*.json, review/REVIEW.md finding D4, map/taxonomy.json ravenReach, audit/*.json. Every mapper no or partial leaf of weight 3, and every row filed, was re-run through Raven on 2026-11-14 between 05:04 and 05:14 UTC: operation search inside the script (codemode.search), then one execute per batch of leaves. Rows that reached a finding were also checked against the upstream surface directly (developers.stellar.org .md pages, the stellar/stellar-docs source, the Scout REST API, stellar.org pages).

evidenceKey.confirmed: reproduced by two lanes or by this lane on 2026-11-14
evidenceKey.single: one observation, or an observation that did not reproduce

rows.title: Missing or wrong memo to an exchange
rows.missing: The recovery path for a deposit sent without its memo: SDF cannot recover the funds; contact the exchange.
rows.ownerNote: SDF publishes the answer at stellar.org/community; Scout's sdf-org research source does not hold that page.

recheck.result: stellarDocs.search_docs returned C-account memo, pooled-accounts, and payment pages. scout.searchResearch returned SEP-0044, SEP-0029, and CAP-0064. lumenloop.search_content_semantic returned the 2020 SDF post 'Fixing memo-less payments'. No returned text gives the recovery path. stellar.org/community (HTTP 200) states it.

rows.recommend: Add stellar.org/community to Scout's sdf-org source (sls-117).

rows.missing: Nothing is missing. The Docs Lumens page says all XLM was created at launch, above its own paragraph on 5.44 billion inflation lumens.

recheck.result: stellarDocs.get_doc_page('/docs/learn/fundamentals/lumens') returned both passages. scout.searchResearch returned the same page with the 2026-07-21 Dashboard API figures (total supply 50,001,786,839.9).

rows.title: Software versions for the current protocol
rows.missing: The rule that the host rejects a contract built for a newer protocol than the network runs, and its error text.
rows.ownerNote: The rule lives only in stellar/rs-soroban-env (soroban-env-host/src/vm/parsed_module.rs). The Docs Environment Meta section says only that the interface version 'should match'.

recheck.result: stellarDocs.search_docs('contract protocol number is newer than host') returned Software Versions, Guestbook, Build Your Own Contract SDK, and State Archival; no text holds the rule. scout.searchResearch (8 rows) and search_sdk_cli_tools_docs also held nothing. At 2026-11-14T05:06:19Z the mapper's other concern did not reproduce: Scout returned the Software Versions page and the Bell upgrade guide for the matching-releases question.

rows.recommend: Add four sentences to the Environment Meta section and one to Software Versions (sd-107 gives the text).

rows.title: Scams, phishing, and impersonation
rows.missing: What a victim should do after a scam. The returned sources are dated 2020 to 2023.
rows.ownerNote: SDF's scam guide (stellar.org blog, updated July 2022) is held by Scout and Lumenloop. Whether the full guide gives victim steps was not established.

recheck.result: scout.searchResearch returned the SDF guide 'Protect Yourself from Scammers' as row 2; lumenloop.search_content_semantic returned the guide, the 2020 email-incident statement, the 2023 security reminders, and the Stellarscam.report origin story. stellarDocs.search_docs returned a threat-model example and unrelated pages. No returned chunk gives victim steps.

rows.recommend: Source-coverage question for the owner: ask SDF to refresh the 2022 guide with an 'if you were scammed' section. Read the guide in full before any filing.
rows.notFiled: The source is held. No defect in it is established; the guide's age alone is not a finding.
